text: This chapter provides information that pertains to planning the design of strength training and conditioning programs. Program design is an overview perspective on what strength training and conditioning coaches should do to prepare athletes for their preparatory and competitive seasons. Properly designed strength training and conditioning programs are vital to any athletic preparation. Strength training and conditioning programs can improve athletic performance, decrease the likelihood of injuries, and allow for the development of sound weightlifting and basic resistance training techniques (18,22,23,30,35).
